record.directions: Use Judith Landing Recreation Area on Highway 236. BLM’s boater guide places the boat take-out downstream of the highway bridge; the campground is upstream. Confirm seasonal access before arranging your shuttle.
record.sourceName: Bureau of Land Management recreation site
record.note: BLM confirms a boat-access facility and publishes this recreation-site coordinate. The exact ramp edge and take-out bank remain unverified; do not substitute the facility marker for the landing.
